title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval a Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Hebrew Rehabilitation Center for Aged.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are Conpetitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul C. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Judith F. Judson and Brian Paul Golden. (DTE 05-GC-19)
